4.11.2 VPC Pricing Concerns 
The eLearning applications cloud services were initially entirely situated within a 
VPC, to utilise its security and isolation benefits. This was particularly important 
given the application will need to handle sensitive educational data and user 
information securely. With services located within the VPC the developer has a 
significant amount of control over the networking elements including the use of 
subnets. 
However, as development progressed it became clear that the data transfer 
costs associated with a VPC were higher than anticipated. The charges were 
primary due to NAT Gateway which allows instances situated within a private 
subnet to connect to the internet or other AWS services. 
To quickly manage these costs, all services that did not need to be with a VPC to 
function were removed, thus reducing the volume of data transfer within the 
VPC.
